title: Make cancellation follow media dependency boundaries

definition.title: Make cancellation follow media dependency boundaries
definition.source_excerpt: Exact WebTransport testing is BLOCKED because WebTransport is undefined in the permitted opaque/non-secure browser context. A bounded independent-GOP scheduler model nevertheless validates the critical state rule: after a seek increments the presentation epoch, a deliberately uncancelled old GOP may complete but cannot publish. The model is not transport performance evidence. Its byte accounting also shows independent speculative streams are not automatically better than a clean HTTP-range abort; scheduling policy matters.
